title: City Council — May 19, 2026 Work Session and Business Meeting

votes.motion: MOTION: Council Member Hyland moved to ADJOURN the City Council Work Session. The motion was seconded by Council Member Holton

MOTION: Council Member Birrell moved to TABLE Ordinance 464 Enacting Code Chapter 9.63, Community Clean Energy Program, to the June 2, 2026 City Council Meeting. The motion was seconded by Mayor Bennion. Mayor Bennion stated that they only learned that an article would not be included in the Cottonwood Heights Journal two weeks previously, which was why they decided to hold the open house so quickly. MOTION: Council Member Birrell moved to APPROVE Ordinance 464 Enacting Code Chapter 9.63, Community Clean Energy Program. The motion was seconded by Mayor Bennion. Vote on Motion: Council Member Birrell-Yes; Council Member Newell-No; Council Member Hyland- No; Council Member Holton-No; Mayor Bennion-Yes

MOTION: Council Member Newell moved to APPROVE Ordinance 465 Amending Code Sections 19.75.050 and 19.76.030 Regarding Separate Utility Meters. The motion was seconded by Council Member Holton. Vote on Motion: Council Member Birrell-Yes; Council Member Hyland-Yes; Council Member Newell-Yes; Council Member Holton-Yes; Mayor Bennion-Yes

MOTION: Council Member Birrell moved to APPROVE Ordinance 466 Adopting a Revised Map provided by UFA showing the hazardous areas in the City being closed to fireworks as amended with the following handwritten changes to the map previously circulated as shown in blue shading on the attachment and a request for UFA to promptly provide a revised final map incorporating those handwritten changes. The additional areas shall include: 1. The area east of Highland Drive, south of Lorita Way, to the Cottonwood Heights City boundary. 2. The area south of Creek Road adjacent to Oakdale Elementary School

MOTION: Council Member Hyland moved to APPROVE Ordinance 467 Granting a Cable TV System Franchise to Comcast of Utah II, Inc. The motion was seconded by Council Member Birrell. Vote on Motion: Council Member Holton-Yes; Council Member Birrell-Yes; Council Member Newell-Yes; Council Member Hyland-Yes; Mayor Bennion-Yes

MOTION: Council Member Birrell moved to APPROVE Resolution 2026-31 Approving an Agreement with H.W. Lochner, Inc. for Design Services for the Bengal Boulevard Pedestrian Trail. The motion was seconded by Council Member Newell. Vote on Motion: Council Member Hyland-Yes; Council Member Newell-Yes; Council Member Birrell-Yes; Council Member Holton-Yes; Mayor Bennion-Yes

MOTION: Council Member Birrell moved to APPROVE Resolution 2026-32 Consenting to Appointments to the Cottonwood Heights Historic Committee. The motion was seconded by Council Member Hyland. Vote on Motion: Council Member Birrell-Yes; Council Member Holton-Yes; Council Member Hyland-Yes; Council Member Newell-Yes; Mayor Bennion-Yes
